mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, it is a pleasant 67 degrees with clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. The moon is in its First Quarter phase. If you are up early, the ISS will be visible tomorrow at 4:09 AM for three minutes, rising in the South Southwest over Belleville and crossing toward the East Northeast over Fitchburg and Madison, peaking halfway up the sky. Tonight's low will be 59 degrees with no rain expected.

The city is currently managing phase two of the Mark Drive reconstruction project, involving underground utility work and street paving. Additionally, the city is continuing its rehabilitation program for several streets including Gateway Pass and Monte Cristo Circle to maintain safe infrastructure.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, and Pizza and a Pitcher at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, keep an eye out for Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus Trivia.
Looking back at the weekly report, on Friday, an officer arrested a 44-year-old woman for a first offence O W I after she was found stopped near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.
Today's delicious flavor is Double Strawberry. Culver's is open until 10 PM, so with only an hour left, now is the perfect time to grab a scoop.
